policy: Add-only. Every review-queue gloss is kept unchanged; this file adds the English evidence English Wiktionary and Wikidata Lexemes supply: resolved form-of lemmas, lexeme senses, close variants and rule-based keys, translation-table equivalents, usage examples with English translations, and romanizations. Words with no English are flagged when their script is rare in the profile or when only other languages have an entry for the spelling. Definitions are ranked (own sense corroborated by a translation table, then own sense in Wiktionary order with obsolete/archaic/rare senses last, then resolved lemma, close variant, translation equivalent). The lead candidate is a reviewer's starting point; nothing is selected or approved.
